name: Kujou Nozomi
source: A classmate attending the same school as [url=/c133400]Hashigo[/url], and a boy who used to be his best friend. Since they were in the same archery club, they used to hang out everyday, but due to a certain incident, their relationship has broken apart. At the moment, he is the last person Hashigo wants to see.
